summary: The hovercraft booms down as they hit. Morpheus opens the lock on the EMP detonator while Trinity watches him. He says of someone off-screen, 'He's going to make it.'

what_changes.before: uncertain whether the person trying to reach the exit will succeed
what_changes.after: convinced the person will succeed, stating 'He's going to make it.'
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus opens the lock on the EMP detonator. Trinity watches him. MORPHEUS He's going to make it.

event_hint.one_line: As the hovercraft is struck, Morpheus readies the EMP and judges that the fleeing crewmate will make it.

uncertain: whether the EMP detonator is actually deployed
what Trinity thinks or intends as she watches
